name: Persona 4: Dancing All Night: Hanate Wotagei! Rise no Dance Battle
summary: Persona 4: Dancing All Night: Hanate Wotagei! Rise no Dance Battle is a Flash game where Teddie battles Rise in a silly but colorful dance-off by timing your mouse clicking to the beat of the music before time runs out. Win or lose, Teddie asks the player to purchase the then-upcoming PlayStation Vita release of Persona 4: Dancing All Night and then tweet about it on Twitter.
